This website uses lamejs 1.2.1 by Alex Zhukov and contributors.
Project: https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs
LAME project: https://lame.sourceforge.net
Package license: GNU LGPL version 3 (see LGPL-3.0.txt and GPL-3.0.txt).
Upstream LICENSE and legacy COPYING notices are also preserved here.
Unmodified browser build: lame.min.js
Original npm package, including source and build scripts: lamejs-1.2.1.tgz
The encoder is loaded as a separate replaceable script by encoder-worker.js.
No audio or analytics data is sent to an external server by this application.
